title: We have grown out of Wilde and paradoxes
html_source:
The times have grown out of Oscar Wilde, he is no longer in fashion.

The previous paradox mentioned being ‘the saying about Caliban’ seeing himself or not seeing himself in the mirror from the prelude to Dorian Grey

A selection of Wilde’s paradoxes:

I can resist anything except temptation.

I have the simplest tastes. I am always satisfied with the best.

Arguments are to be avoided; they are always vulgar and often convincing.

Many have become popular idioms.
